description: Tranquility is an independent game development team focused on creating immersive experiences through storytelling, creativity, and gameplay. We believe in collaboration, sharing ideas, and bringing imaginative worlds to life. We're always happy to welcome new members who share our passion for creating games and want to be part of our journey!
summary: An innovative 2D educational game that combines space exploration, storytelling, and interactive gameplay to make learning more engaging for high school students. Featuring an Apollo 13 story mode and a creative mode, the game encourages players to learn about space through interactive objects and fun mini-games. Although still in its demo stage, the project demonstrates strong potential to transform traditional museum visits into immersive and memorable educational experiences, inspiring students to explore science and space.
details:
We developed a 2D educational game designed for high school students visiting space museums as part of educational trips. The game transforms the museum learning experience into an interactive adventure, allowing students to explore space-related environments, interact with objects, and complete engaging mini-games that encourage learning through exploration and play.

The game features two distinct modes: Apollo 13 Story Mode, where players experience and learn about the events of the Apollo 13 mission through a story-driven experience, and Creative Mode, where players can use their imagination to experiment, create, and explore space concepts in their own way.

Our goal is to make space education more engaging, accessible, and memorable by combining storytelling, interactivity, and creativity. By turning educational content into an enjoyable gaming experience, we aim to encourage students to develop an interest in space exploration, science, and NASA's missions.

The project is currently a working demo, showcasing our core concept and gameplay mechanics, with further development planned.
